## Quickstart
```python
import os
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(
base\_url="https://api.tokenfactory.us-central1.nebius.com/v1/",
api\_key=os.environ.get("NEBIUS\_API\_KEY")
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
model="nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b",
messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain quantum computing in one sentence."}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```
## Try it Out
[▶ Try it in the Token Factory Playground](https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/playground?models=nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b)
## TL;DR
Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B is NVIDIA's flagship 550B hybrid MoE model on Nebius Token Factory, optimized for demanding multi-agent AI and complex reasoning tasks.
- \*\*Provider:\*\* NVIDIA
- \*\*Flavor:\*\* Base
- \*\*Region:\*\* `us-central1`
- \*\*Architecture:\*\* Hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) — 550B total / 55B active parameters
- \*\*Context window:\*\* 1M tokens
- \*\*Modality:\*\* Text-to-text
- \*\*Quantization:\*\* FP4
- \*\*Pricing:\*\* \$1.00 / 1M input tokens, \$3.00 / 1M output tokens
- \*\*Strengths:\*\* Complex reasoning, multi-agent workflows, tool calling, long-context tasks
- \*\*License:\*\* `nvidia-open-model-license`
### Key highlights
- Ultra-tier Nemotron 3 model available through Nebius Token Factory
- Activates 55B parameters from a 550B-parameter hybrid MoE architecture
- Supports reasoning and tool calling for agentic workflows
- Runs on the `us-central1` Token Factory endpoint
- Exposes an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API

# NVIDIA Nemotron Models

Browse NVIDIA Nemotron models available on Nebius Token Factory.

---

## Available Nemotron Models

| Model | Provider | Parameters | Context | Highlights |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nemotron-3.5-Lightning  ▶ Try it @ TF | NVIDIA | 30B total   3B active | 1 M | Fast, low-cost MoE model built as the execution layer for always-on, long-running agents and high-throughput specialized tasks |
| Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B  ▶ Try it @ TF | NVIDIA | 120B total   12B active | 256 K | hybrid MoE model optimized for efficient multi-agent AI and complex reasoning tasks. |
| Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B  ▶ Try it @ TF | NVIDIA | 550B total   55B active | 1 M | Flagship hybrid MoE model optimized for the most demanding multi-agent AI and complex reasoning tasks |



---

## Running the Notebooks

This directory is a uv project. From the repo root:

```
cd models/nemotron
uv sync
```

Create a `.env` file with your Nebius API key (get one at tokenfactory.nebius.com):

```
cp env.example .env
# then edit .env and paste your key
```

Start Jupyter and open a notebook:

```
uv run jupyter lab run_nemotron.ipynb
```

| Notebook | Model | Runs on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| run\_nemotron.ipynb | `nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning` | Local (minimal) |
| run\_nemotron\_colab.ipynb | `nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning` | Google Colab or local |

# Model Deprecations: November 2026
> Models soon leaving Token Factory Serverless with recommended migration paths.
> [!NOTE]
>
> \*\*On November 9, 2026:\*\*
>
> \* Affected Serverless models will no longer be available via API or Playground.
> \* Dedicated Endpoints for these models will be unaffected by this change.
## What to Know
These models will be removed from Token Factory Serverless on \*\*November 9, 2026\*\*. After that date, you will not be able to select them in the Playground or send API requests using their model IDs.
\* This change only affects Serverless usage. [Dedicated Endpoints](https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/endpoints/create-dedicated-endpoint) are unaffected.
\* Token Factory does not automatically reroute requests from deprecated models.
\* Choose a replacement based on your workload, then test before migrating traffic.

## Preparing to Migrate
1. Identify applications and workflows that send requests to a deprecating model ID.
2. Compare the replacement model's capabilities, performance and price.
3. Test prompts, inputs and workloads to verify the new model will work for your use cases.
4. Update the `model` and `base\_url` values in your API requests, then verify the results.
Refer to our [quick start guide](https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/quickstart.md) for reference and up to date examples.
## Consider a Dedicated Endpoint
For production workloads that need stable model versions or custom configurations, consider [Dedicated Endpoints](https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/endpoints/create-dedicated-endpoint), which provide:
\* Control over model versions and deployments.
\* Dedicated capacity and configurable scaling.
\* Workload isolation.
To learn more about Dedicated Endpoints or for help getting started, contact our team:
👉 [Contact Token Factory Sales](https://nebius.com/services/token-factory/enterprise-grade-inference#token-factory-enterprise-sales-form)
